items.label: Background room 2025/09
items.text: Frame 「3_edit_mask_room」 titled 「Background」: canvas with an info button, Background panel with chips Favorite / Trendy / Back to School / Smoke / Tennis / Nature, an add-image thumbnail first, then background thumbnails; bottom bar 「bottom_action/4icons」; the panel's undo / redo icons are hidden layers

items.label: AI Background room 2025/09
items.text: Frame 「3_edit_mask_room」 titled 「AI Background」: chips Custom / Trendy / Back to School / Smoke / Tennis / Nature, thumbnails, credit box 「Cost 2 credit per creation」 with a credit button

items.label: On-canvas undo / redo 2025/09
items.text: Frame 「5」 (Text to image): undo and redo drawn as on-canvas icons (editing_area/ic_undo_n, ic_redo_n) at the canvas bottom-left, a continuous slider, capsule tabs, thumbnails, X and ✓ at the bottom
